A worked example.

An item with a tezka number of 27 is teztu.

The Drizel scheme.

Every item in the Drizel scheme carries a tezka number, which is a whole number.

The Lumlum rule set.

Inputs entering the Lumlum rule set are marked with a class word.

The exception.

There is one exception. An input whose class is xilnak is given the kadri outcome instead.

Entries.

A solclo is paired with value kaxil.
A tuqen is paired with value tuzam.
A zamyuk is paired with value tuvor.
A tezmi is paired with value clofex.

Any entry whose type is not listed goes to the oviqen value.

A note on precedence.

The table above is complete. Do not infer a value from the name of an entry type; use only the entries given here.

The general rule.

The standard outcome is yuknak.

The Ovivor rule set.

Inputs entering the Ovivor rule set are marked with a class word.

The Clotu table.

Entries in the Clotu table are paired by their type.

The exception.

There is one exception. An input whose class is zelxil is given the nakclo outcome instead.
